_doc: Gate-6 Repository Construction Contract — machine-readable change-class registry. Every repository change declares its classes in a BUILD_IMPACT_MANIFEST; scripts/governance/construction_protocol.py validates manifests and RUNS the required checks (results are never log-trusted). Checks are pytest node paths or scripts. Extend classes here + tests/test_construction_protocol.py together.

FEATURE_IDENTITY_CHANGE.description: Add/rename/retire a governed feature identity (FM-id, lifecycle, name).
FEATURE_IDENTITY_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: revert ontology + registry + regenerated artifacts in one commit
FEATURE_IDENTITY_CHANGE.completion_criteria: all required checks green; census fresh; lineage exhaustive

FORMULA_CHANGE.description: Change the mathematics of a registered formula or add a new one.
FORMULA_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: single commit; parity floors define byte-equivalence evidence
FORMULA_CHANGE.completion_criteria: parity + lint + census-fresh green; threshold recalibration flagged if active denominator changed

DERIVED_METRIC_CHANGE.completion_criteria: pipeline<->scalar parity green; lifecycle set; census fresh

DATASET_SCHEMA_CHANGE.description: Change CANONICAL_FEATURES / feature vector schema / dataset builders.
DATASET_SCHEMA_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: schema hash is load-bearing — baseline_capture required before training

MODEL_INPUT_CHANGE.description: Change which features/values feed a model at train or serve time.
MODEL_INPUT_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: single commit; train/serve-skew check mandatory (F-050 lesson)
MODEL_INPUT_CHANGE.completion_criteria: lineage updated; train-time and serve-time sources named + identical or skew documented

MODEL_TRAINING_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: training artifacts versioned via model_registry GOV-3 atomic promotion
MODEL_TRAINING_CHANGE.completion_criteria: label provenance documented (forward_walk vs F-022 stream); no silent label reuse

ACTIVE_MODEL_CHANGE.description: Activate/deactivate/rewire a model in the live/backtest spine.
ACTIVE_MODEL_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: config-first: activation via config keys, never code branches (§6.5)
ACTIVE_MODEL_CHANGE.completion_criteria: registry + config + findings consistent; §6.5 authority ladder respected

PRODUCTION_CONFIG_CHANGE.completion_criteria: USER APPROVAL required (active-config edits are always user-gated); reachability green; hash valid

TRACE_OBSERVATION_JOIN.description: Extend an OBSERVATION-ONLY runtime trace stream with new joined or derived metadata fields (e.g. the CRTConstructionTrace resolver envelope). Strictly no decision path, no canonical quantity, no CANONICAL_FEATURES change, no claim-catalog change. Deliberately NOT RUNTIME_DECISION_PATH_CHANGE: classifying an observation-only join as a decision-path change would be a false claim, and the two carry different completion criteria (parity-of-ledger vs proof-of-non-participation).
artifacts_to_update: the emitting module's own schema_version + config section
TRACE_OBSERVATION_JOIN.rollback_boundary: single commit; the trace schema bump, the emitter fields and the producing read-only accessor revert together
TRACE_OBSERVATION_JOIN.completion_criteria: the emitting section stays OBSERVATION_ONLY and default-off; every new field present on BOTH warmup and live rows (uniform shape); any newly-called producer proven not to mutate its own subject (a behaviour-neutrality test, not an assertion in prose); and no new field carries a rival authority label for a quantity another module already owns

RUNTIME_DECISION_PATH_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: determinism gate: 2-instrument byte-identical ledger unless behavior change is the declared intent
RUNTIME_DECISION_PATH_CHANGE.completion_criteria: behavior-change declared + finding filed OR parity proof (byte-identical)

artifacts_to_update: grandfather retirement manifest if a GD site
DEAD_CODE_REMOVAL.rollback_boundary: single commit; §6.2 rule 4 (preserve history in git, mark superseded in docs)
DEAD_CODE_REMOVAL.completion_criteria: 0-caller evidence cited; census fresh after removal

DOCUMENTATION_ONLY.description: Docs/comments/findings text only — no behavior surface.
DOCUMENTATION_ONLY.completion_criteria: doc floors green; no src/config diff (validator enforces)

SCRIPT_LIFECYCLE_CHANGE.description: Add/move/classify/retire a script registry record or related SITS artifacts; register new scripts under scripts/** or repo-root *.py.
SCRIPT_LIFECYCLE_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: single commit; stubs + overlays + grandfather pin are PRIMARY
SCRIPT_LIFECYCLE_CHANGE.completion_criteria: tests/test_script_registry.py green (coverage + grandfather ratchet); seed dump deterministic; every declared new scripts/**/*.py or root *.py path present in registry non-terminal records with purpose != GRANDFATHER_UNCLASSIFIED

IDENTITY_STORE_CHANGE.description: Add or change the identity-store substrate (Class A declaration snapshots, Class B identity records, Class C tracked bindings, Identity Check, writers/readers). Not the live decision path. Load must not import feature_pipeline / feature_states / feature_schema / crt_engine / crt_state_resolver as a substitute for stored identity.
IDENTITY_STORE_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: single commit; revert src/identity/ + tests/test_identity_store.py + this class if added in the same change
IDENTITY_STORE_CHANGE.completion_criteria: Identity Check round-trip PRESERVED for L0–L5; missing PK / hash mismatch / dropped RESET fail closed; AST isolation: check/reader do not import recompute producers

CORPUS_AUTHORITY_CHANGE.description: Add or change Dataset Identity records, the dataset-identity schema/registry, or the load-time corpus admission gate (R3). Owns which physical OHLCV artifact a governed load may stream. Not L0-L5 identity store, not live decision scoring, not G001, not OHLCV CLOSED.
CORPUS_AUTHORITY_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: single commit; revert dataset records + dataset_registry.py + CandleLoader admit wire + this class if added in the same change. Phase-1 XAUUSD guard must remain fail-closed.
CORPUS_AUTHORITY_CHANGE.completion_criteria: Bound XAUUSD M15 loads still rewrite to data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv @ 4d73f5ce and fail closed on hash/range drift; unbound instruments path-passthrough; native XAUUSD HTF CSVs rejected as FORENSIC; projections have no file path; decision_status is not APPROVED; OHLCV_CLOSURE_STATUS unchanged.

SEMANTIC_REGISTRY_CHANGE.description: Add or refine a node in a NON-frozen semantic section of the market ontology (structural_predicates / structural_walks / canonical_unknowns / htf_states / objectives / execution_behaviours / invariants / regimes / ...), or the sibling data that declares how those nodes are policed or founded. Declaration-only: these sections are never read on the runtime binding path (market_ontology.yaml spec_schema.semantic_registry), so this class asserts NO production behaviour change. Meaning-origin edits per CLAUDE.md 6.6; grants no production, promotion or G001 authority per 6.5.
artifacts_to_update: configs/formulas/market_ontology.yaml (the node, refined IN PLACE - never a duplicate id)
docs/current-findings.md when the node records or overturns a conclusion
SEMANTIC_REGISTRY_CHANGE.completion_criteria: validate_semantic_registry() == [] and validate_registry() == []; every new id GROUNDED via query_semantic_os.py --ground --kind NOUN; frozen runtime sections (primitives/feature_compositions/derived_metrics) byte-unchanged; production config hash unchanged; nodes refined IN PLACE with version bumped, never duplicated. If the node names an impl, that impl must be reachable and policed - registration WITHOUT enforcement is an incomplete change (the failure mode that produced this class).
SEMANTIC_REGISTRY_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: single commit; the ontology node is PRIMARY. Reverting must not orphan a test pin or leave a policed-section name pointing at a deleted section.

JSONL_CLAIM_SURFACE_CHANGE.description: Add or refine the JSONL claim catalog (CC-* claim classes / STR-* streams / forbidden_joins), the SemanticGrounder JSONL claim kind and REFUSED status, the CT-008 refine-in-place, or the measurement result log. Advisory anti-hallucination surface: it decides whether a JSONL stream may CLOSE an LLM claim, nothing else. NOT identity persistence (no Class A/B/C record, no identity_check on run-level lines), NOT the live spine, NOT G001 or promotion, and NOT SEMANTIC_REGISTRY_CHANGE (that class is the non-frozen market-ontology sections in market_ontology.yaml; CT-008 lives in docs/governance/semantic_os/contracts.yaml).
artifacts_to_update: docs/governance/jsonl_claim_catalog.yaml (the PRIMARY; never hand-edit the data/ projection)
docs/reference/schemas.md (S9.15 catalog line, S9.16 result line, S9.14 Grounding)
docs/governance/SEMANTIC_OS_CONTRACT.md (S10) and CT-008 refined IN PLACE - never a new CT-id
CLAUDE.md S6.7 + the machine-readable truth-sources table
docs/topics/ (the one topic doc the change touches, per S6.4)
JSONL_CLAIM_SURFACE_CHANGE.completion_criteria: load_catalog() validates and every CC-*/STR-* id is unique; no CANNOT class appears in any stream allowed_cc and every forbidden_cc is a subset of the CANNOT ids; the GENERATED data/jsonl_claim_catalog.jsonl equals a fresh deterministic render; every meaning_authority entry is the INVENTORY_NOT_MARKET sentinel or GROUNDs as a NOUN (no invented SEM/CN/FM ids); catalog authority stays 'advisory'; frozen ontology runtime sections (primitives/feature_compositions/derived_metrics) byte-unchanged; production config hash unchanged; no G001, promotion, ACTIVE_VERSION or live-rail key introduced. PR-2 adds: every CANNOT class returns REFUSED; a missing or non-CC-* relation is UNANSWERABLE; a forbidden join refuses BEFORE any CAN can ground; a CAN outside the stream's allowed_cc is UNANSWERABLE (never a silent GROUND); path-escape tokens are UNKNOWN and never opened; the agent envelope carries grounding_status before status is set to 'ok'; CT-008 is refined IN PLACE with its id and all 18 required keys intact; and the four original claim kinds still ground unchanged. PR-3 adds: every git-tracked instances/MC-*.json with mt00 != UNRUN has a result line whose artifact hashes match; classify_l5_basis checks FIVE keys against five frozensets and never iterates identity.tokens.L5_BASIS (3 keys, no geometry); identity_check is never called on a run-level line and basis_status is never PRESERVED; economic_claims_allowed is const false; and the result log file is NOT a GOVERNED_FILE so appends do not re-run the floor.
JSONL_CLAIM_SURFACE_CHANGE.rollback_boundary: Single commit. The catalog YAML is PRIMARY: revert the YAML, the loader, the grounder change and the tests together. Reverting must not leave a GREEN_FLOOR or required_checks entry pointing at a deleted test.
